ContextMenu__Description: Custom right-click context menu system for TrueVision3D. Desktop mouse only, Orbit mode only. The gesture guard is deliberately strict because the right mouse button is the Orbit pan gesture - any pointer travel beyond MaxTravelPx latches the menu off for that entire press, so panning can never be interrupted by a menu.

ContextMenu__Gesture.ContextMenu__Gesture__Description: Right-click qualification rules. MaxTravelPx is the total pointer travel (px, either axis) tolerated between pointerdown and the contextmenu event; exceeding it disarms the menu for that press and it cannot re-arm even if the pointer returns to the origin. MaxHoldMs of 0 disables the hold-time check entirely.

ContextMenu__Picking.ContextMenu__Picking__Description: Raycast rules for resolving which model element was right-clicked. Linework roots are excluded because fat lines (LineSegments2) extend THREE.Mesh and would otherwise win the hit test over the solid geometry behind them.

ContextMenu__Ui.ContextMenu__Ui__Description: Menu presentation. Offsets and padding are CSS pixels. The menu is positioned at the pointer and clamped inside the viewport.

ContextMenu__Sections.ContextMenu__Sections__Description: Per-section master switches. Sections are contributed by registered provider modules and render in ascending order value. Object-interaction sections sit above the model-visibility sections, separated by a rule.

ContextMenu__ElementDisplayNames.ContextMenu__ElementDisplayNames__Descri: Element-type key to menu label. Keys are the element portion of a category name (Storey__GroundFloor__ProposedWalls -> ProposedWalls). Anything not listed falls back to an auto-generated CamelCase split.

ContextMenu__Labels.ContextMenu__Labels__Description: Menu row wording. {element} and {floor} are substituted at render time. IsolateFloor names the whole storey in the label rather than in a scope tag, because it switches an entire floor level on rather than acting on the element that was clicked; it also sits in its own divided group for the same reason.
